Subject: PO, net terms and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment

Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement here at OpenFusion needs to confirm a few items before we can route a PO: PO must include a PO number, billing entity, BU code, cost-center mapping, and match the invoice line items. Our standard is net60, but we can consider earlier payment if there is an approved discount.

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can accept monthly invoices with a consolidated PO reference?
- Whether a 2% payment-within-15-days discount is possible (we can commit to that internally if you accept)?
- Any required PO field formatting (we'll attach our template).

Attached: OpenFusion PO template (xlsx).

Best,
Evan

On Sat, Apr 10, 2027 at 9:14 AM, Evan Holt <evan@openfusion.com> wrote:
> Jonas —
>
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday...

Evan — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: yes to monthly consolidated invoices referencing a single PO, and yes we can accept PO field mapping, but we need to align on the exact fields to guarantee ERP matching.

About the 2% / 15-day discount: we typically offer an early-pay discount as a billing-level credit (applied on receipt of payment). I don't have final sign-off for a 2% figure in this deal yet — I'll loop finance. Would Redwood accept net45 if OpenFusion needs net60 but wants a tiered discount (2% within 15d, 1% within 30d)? That would help us keep committed revenue while giving you the early-pay incentive.

I've attached our most recent order form for legal and billing fields so we can mark required attributes. I'll also put Vanessa (billing ops) and Marissa (account exec) on this thread to coordinate the PO mapping and timing.

Next step: Vanessa, can you confirm required Redwood PO fields and whether we can programmatically accept the BU/cost-center fields from their template?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO, net terms and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment

Evan / team —

Thanks for the PO template, Evan. We reviewed it with Finance. Required fields we need for straight-through ERP matching: PO number, billing entity name (as registered with Redwood), invoice remit address, invoice currency, invoice line item description, line-level amount, BU code (optional but helps reconciliation), and cost-center mapping. If any of those map to different columns in your ERP, we can accept a mapper file but the PO PDF or xlsx must contain the values.

Invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoice is fine, with invoice date = last calendar day of the month. We will include the PO number and line-item references on every invoice. If OpenFusion prefers net60 by policy, Redwood can accommodate net60 for this contract provided: 
- Payment term is explicitly stated on the order form/PO; and
- An early-payment discount is set as a separate billing credit (we can automate application after payment is posted).

On the discount levels: Finance is comfortable signing off on the following compromise: net60 as primary term, with a 1.5% early pay discount if paid within 15 days and 0.75% if paid within 30 days. We won't be able to commit to 2% without a larger multi-quarter commitment.

Marissa will handle the formal quote revision to reflect net60 + tiered early-pay credits. Sean, Finance, please confirm that the discount will be applied as a post-payment credit and whether we need a separate SOW amendment.

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-11T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO, net terms and invoice cadence for Redwood deployment

Vanessa / team —

Confirming finance position: we can accept net60 as the contractual term for OpenFusion. Early-pay incentives are permitted but must be encoded as billing credits (ledger-level) tied to payment date, not as a change to the invoice gross amount. That protects revenue recognition and our deferred revenue calculations.

Proposed wording for the order form: 
"OpenFusion will pay invoices net sixty (60) days. Redwood will apply an early payment credit of 1.5% of the invoice gross amount if Redwood receives cleared payment within fifteen (15) days of the invoice date, and 0.75% if payment clears within thirty (30) days. Credits will be applied to the next invoice following payment posting."

If legal or revenue ops want, we can add an alternative clause for a 2% discount if OpenFusion signs a 12-month committed volume clause (we'd need to size the commitment). Otherwise the 1.5%/0.75% ladder is approved.

I'll leave the SOW/amendment question to Legal; from Finance POV no separate SOW required if the terms are captured on the order form and printed on the PO.

-Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
